turns.q: If they want to exchange it, how would that work?
turns.replyTail: The purifier must be returned in its original packaging, and it will be tested and inspected after receipt. Return shipping costs are the customer’s responsibility and may be deducted from any refund. The return must include a Return Authorization on an Alen-provided FedEx return label; without that label and RA number, the exchange may be delayed or voided. Exchanges are not accepted after 60 days. If the item was purchased through a third-party reseller, the reseller’s exchange policy applies.
